reviews.title: Perfectly sized mATX case! Best one I’ve ever seen
reviews.comment:
I love this case! It is perfect and it was just what I needed for my build. As someone who values desk space and was coming from have a sff pc that was in a fractal terra jade case, this case fit my requirements perfectly.
It is a little on the girthy and wider side, but that helps as you have more room to work and also for ventilation. I was able to fit 9 fans in here, the 3 that come with the case, and I had a 360 mm AIO on that that fit with enough space and 3 intake fans at the bottom as well.
The fan/connection hub in the back is great and lets you add more fans than what your motherboard will allow, but forewarning, doesn’t have any fan sensors built in, so dont be shocked if you can’t manually control the speed of each fan.
The quality of the temper glass is strong and durable, as well as the metal parts of the case.
I will say the most annoying part is that there is no physical manual that comes with it, but there is a QR code that you can scan that’ll take you online to see how to build it.
Also, it is a bit uncomfortable to connect the front usb 3.2 case connectors to your motherboard as while it seems like it’s a straight angle, since the case cable is a bit short and the angle is tight, you have to finagle with it a lot while connecting it to the port on the motherboard, so maybe investing in a 90 degree adapter would be a good idea.
For size and context, the gpu that is installed is a 9070 Hellhound, and as you can see, I still have space to spare and the case comes with a built in support bracket for the gpu. I don’t really use it however as it would sit directly on top of one of the gpu fans.
All in all, I am very satisfied with the case and would highly recommend this to anyone who wants to have the appeal of seeing your parts like a big fish tank pc case, without taking up all the space in your desk.
reviews.author: Benniccette Perez Pena

reviews.title: Above Average Micro ATX PC Case
reviews.comment: I like the case. Great airflow and looks. Plus it fits big graphics cards and 360mm radiators/aio’s. I swapped the stocks fans with 6 bequiet silent wings 4 fans to increase airflow while still keeping noise low. Only issue i had with the case is that it would be nice if the metal was a little thicker. It bends extremely easy with very little force applied. Other than that, the case is awesome.
